```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

Random value
```{r}
n <- 7

df <- tibble(
  run_name = c(
    "max_df-0.5",
    "max_df-0.8",
    "ngram_range-(1, 1)",
    "ngram_range-(1, 5)",
    "neighbors-5",
    "neighbors-30",
    "base"
  ),
  corr = rnorm(n, mean = 0.5, sd = 0.05),
  similarity = rnorm(n, mean = 0.7, sd = 0.1),
  n = sample(120:150, n, replace = TRUE),
  param = str_extract(run_name, "^[^-]+")
)


base_row <- df %>%
  filter(param == "base") %>%
  select(-param)
duplicated_row <- crossing(base_row, param = setdiff(df$param, "base"))

df <- df %>%
  filter(param != "base") %>%
  bind_rows(duplicated_row)

df
```

Real value
```{r}
df <- read.csv("../results/robustness_check/results.csv")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    param = str_extract(run_name, "(?<=bertopic_-?)[^-]+")
  )

base_row <- df %>%
  filter(run_name == "base") %>%
  select(-param)
duplicated_row <- crossing(base_row, param = setdiff(df$param[!is.na(df$param)], "base"))

df <- df %>%
  filter(param != "base") %>%
  bind_rows(duplicated_row)

df
```



```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = param, y = corr)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = run_name)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .2),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Correlation",
    color = "Hyperparameter value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(5, "pt"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(7, "pt"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black", angle = 70, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 10, 15)
  )

ggsave("../results/fig/robustness_corr.tiff", bg = "white",  width = 12, height = 6)
```

